start.speaker: Feren
start.content: Hey there! Careful in the next room. I've been hearing some nasty sounds coming from in there.

warning.speaker: Feren
warning.content: Don't worry though! If anything attacks you, just press the P key to fight back!

unsure.speaker: Feren
unsure.content: Or... was it L? Maybe Backspace?

choices.content: You don't actually know, do you?

admit.speaker: Feren
admit.content: Of course I know! It's definitely somewhere on the keyboard...

guess.speaker: Feren
guess.content: Try the number pad! One of those ought to do something.
